PDF links

Three links, two of them to a PDF. A PDF-editing extension that decorates links whose path ends in .pdf puts its button after the first two and leaves the third alone. The page is served under the runner's nip.io name: such an extension offers no button on a loopback, private-range or single-label host, where its upload API could not fetch the file.
